title: StateBros Mod
description: This mod is all about me! Like actually there are random stuff in there about me... StateBros
body:
# DISCLAIMER: I lost EVERYTHING in my mod folder on my PC so this mod will never be updated again :( but this mod will stay on modrinth tho for anyone to play 


# Whats in the mod!

**StateBros Biome**: Now spawn underground or above ground, StateBros mobs spawn there, houses the StateBros Trees, and sometime is underwater... so its a bit weird...

**StateBros Block**: Just a block with my logo on it, you can craft it with 4 StateBros ingots

**StateBros Ingot**: This ingot lets you craft the StateBros sword, from smelting the StateBros Ore, which you then get the ingot

**StateBros Sword**: Does 10 damage. Crafted from 2 StateBros ingots and one stick (Like a normal sword)

**StateBros Fluid**: You craft it.

**StateBros Dimension**: Just.. StateBros Biome EVERYWHERE...

**Red house**: Its a red house.... spawns in StateBros Biome.... you can find a lot.

**StateBros Lighter**: You craft it with a StateBros Ingot and a StateBros Sword, and its how you get into the StateBros Dimension.

**StateBros Wood type**: Just a wood type, comes with all the wood stuffs. The log/wood is a bit broken right now as you must crouch to place blocks on them.

**Wobblylife011 Boss**: Drops a OP Wobblylife011 Sword, you craft a wobblylife011 block, then you break the block to get the spawn egg.

**StateBros Meat**: You kill the StateBros mob and then you can cook it to get the cooked version.

**Cheese**: 🧀 

**StateBros Pizza**: You get it from the StateBros tree (with a 1/200 chance) OR you can craft it.

**StateBros Tree**: Its a very red tree.. and leaves just decay on their own even if the tree is still standing.
